name: 99. Anthropic tool-schema compatibility through OpenAI Responses (tool-schema-compat)
description: Regression coverage for OpenAI Responses requests routed to Claude. The success cases pin normalization of root oneOf, anyOf, and allOf schemas (including the Codex-style referenced union and streaming path). The rejection cases pin bounded branch expansion and recursion depth as caller-facing HTTP 400 errors. The deferred $ref-sibling case is intentionally excluded.

// A 200 stream can still end in an error frame or stop early, so the frames are parsed.
pm.test('Streaming Codex root oneOf tool schema: the stream completes without an error event', function () {
var errors = events.filter(function (ev) { return ev.type === 'error' || ev.type === 'response.failed' || ev.type === 'response.incomplete' || (!ev.type && ev.error); });
pm.expect(errors.length, 'stream ended in an error or incomplete event: ' + JSON.stringify(errors[0] || null).slice(0, 400)).to.equal(0);
pm.expect(events.some(function (ev) { return ev.type === 'response.completed'; }), 'no response.completed, so the stream was cut short: ' + text.slice(-400)).to.equal(true);
